STAGE: instantiate the spec at one RQ level (l=1, d=2).

What I read: the SPECIFICATION/SPEC EQUATIONS only (no codebooks, no tests, no other derivations). Goal: collapse the L-level Mobius recursion to a closed form the verifier can check, keeping every piece of the geometry.

Observations while reducing: for L=1 the encoding step is p_1 = (p_0 (-) C_1[k_1]) (+) A_1 with A_1 = exp_0(rho^0 t_i) = exp_0(t_i), and the decode is x_hat = q_0 = (q_1 (-) A_1) (+) C_1[k_1] with q_1 = 0, i.e. x_hat = (-A_1) (+) C_1[k_1] -- the reconstruction depends on the code and the frozen anchor only, never on x, exactly as RQ decoding should. The differentiable loss therefore has two terms: the squared geodesic residual d_c(x, x_hat)^2 = (2 artanh||(-x)(+)x_hat||)^2, and the commitment term ||log_0(p_0) - W_1[k_1]||^2 on the tangent side, weighted by the baseline weight beta.

With c=1, x(+)y = ((1+2<x,y>+||y||^2)x + (1-||x||^2)y)/(1+2<x,y>+||x||^2||y||^2). I expanded each Mobius sum by hand into coordinate form, sign-checked: (-x)(+)y has <-x,y> = -sx, so numerator (1 - 2sx + ||y||^2)(-x) + (1-||x||^2)y over 1 - 2sx + ||x||^2||y||^2, and likewise for p(-)C (inner product -<x,C>). All divisions use norms clamped at 1e-8 so exp_0(0)=0 and log_0(0)=0 come out clean in both SymPy (Max) and torch (clamp_min).

Still open: nothing to run -- writing the symbolic statements, the matching torch module, and stating which discrete steps are excluded from differentiation.

args: x(width 2), w(width 2), t(width 2), beta(scalar)

output: L
excluded: argmin_k d_c(p_0, C_1[k]) (discrete code choice, supplied as the fixed w / straight-through), and the frozen successor-anchor preprocessing (rsvd of the train transition matrix, sign fix, t_i = tau b_i/max(||b_i||,eps), A_l = exp_0(rho^{l-1} t_i))
END IDEA

Consistency audit done before delivery (no execution available, so by hand): every Mobius sum in the torch module uses the single generic form ((1+2<u,v>+||v||^2)u + (1-||u||^2)v)/(1+2<u,v>+||u||^2||v||^2) with c=1, and each hand-expanded SymPy statement is that same form with the substitutions u=x,v=-C (encode step 1: <x,-C> = -s1, ||v||^2 = ny2, den = 1 - 2 s1 + nx2 ny2), u=p(-)C, v=A (<u,v> = su, den = 1 + 2 su + nu2 na2), u=-A, v=C (den = 1 - 2 s2 + na2 ny2, decode q1=0), u=-x, v=x_hat (den = 1 - 2 sx + nx2 nxh2). The residual norm is < 1 for ball inputs, so 2*atanh(nr) is finite; norm clamps at 1e-8 match SymPy Max and give exp_0(0)=0, log_0(0)=0.

STEP 1 (plan). Goal: read the specification of "successor-framed residual quantization" and fix a signature + formula skeleton before writing anything. Read: the task text only (no other files exist for me; I must not ask for other derivations). Observation: the mechanism is (a) clip encoder tangent to ||z||<=R=atanh(0.9), (b) x=exp_0(z), (c) L levels of hyperbolic residual quantization where each level subtracts the chosen code point and adds a frozen anchor frame A_l(i)=exp_0(rho^{l-1} t_i), (d) decode by the mirror recursion from q_L=0, (e) loss = d_c(x, x_hat)^2. Decision: the differentiable output I derive is the per-item geodesic reconstruction term mean_i d_c(x_i,x_hat_i)^2; the commitment/usage terms are excluded because their weights (beta_cm, usage weight) are "exactly the baseline config" values that this specification never states. Signature fixed verbatim from INPUTS AND OUTPUTS: z_i (batch x d), W_l (K x d), t_i (num_items x d), use_behaviour, use_curvature, c=1 (constant, documented default, not an argument). I instantiate the symbolic skeleton at d=1, K=2, L=2 (smallest case that exercises two codebook choices and two levels); the torch module stays generic in d, K, L. Open: writing the SymPy statements and the matching module.

STEP 2 (derivation, checks done on paper). Key algebraic facts verified symbolically by hand for curvature c: (i) general-c Mobius addition ((1+2c<x,y>+c||y||^2)x+(1-c||x||^2)y)/(1+2c<x,y>+c^2||x||^2||y||^2) reduces, in d=1, to (x+y)/(1+c x y) - verified by expanding numerator to (x+y)(1+cxy) and denominator to (1+cxy)^2; at c=0 it is exactly x+y, so the formula is regular at the Euclidean switch (no 0/0). (ii) Substitution y->-y gives p (-) y = (p-y)/(1-c p y), so d_c(p,y)=2 artanh(|(y-p)/(1-cpy)|) uses an argument that is always <1 for ball points (|p y|<1), so the artanh is real and finite. (iii) exp_0(v)=tanh(|v|)v/|v| is, in d=1, the scalar es*v with es=tanh(|v|)/|v| and es->1 at v=0, so tanh(|v|)/max(|v|,1e-12) is the numerically safe scale. (iv) Decode check: the specification's decoder starts at q_L=0, so q_1=(-A_2)(+)C_2=(C_2-A_2)/(1-c A_2 C_2) and q_0=((q_1-A_1)/(1-c q_1 A_1)+C_1)/(1+c((q_1-A_1)/(1-c q_1 A_1))C_1); this equals p_1 only if p_2=0, i.e. the spec's "exact inversion" claim does not hold from q_L=0, but the explicit recursion is authoritative and is what I encode. Flags: use_behaviour gates the anchor tangent (t_eff = use_behaviour*t, so 0 gives plain hyperbolic RQ), use_curvature gates curvature c in {0,1} via the blend c*hyp+(1-c)*euclid on exp_0 and on the distance (blend needed because (2/sqrt c)artanh(sqrt c z) is singular at c=0).
